## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0de24c02b390ebefe2fe33fc93cfc97c83f5eec9`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md + none

Inputs read: card #31112 (body + all 10 comments, incl. claim 6727530009 and dev report 6727833568), PR #31706 (body, 5-file list, `git diff origin/main...pr/31706` = 3bc338ed + a merge of `main`), the check-runs on `0de24c02`. The remainder of the diff (`.changeset/31112-ui-skill-examples-checked.md`) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`; it is read here only for ②.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set of `check:skill-examples` grows by 10 blocks** (objectstack-ui 15 → 25 of 33 `ts`/`typescript` fences): actions 4→5/5, dashboards 4→8/9, list-views 3→5/11, pages 1→4/4 (+ the pre-existing `tsx` master/detail block, which `FENCE_OPEN_RE` already recognises, so its marker was never an orphan). Counted on the head tree: fences and markers match the dev report exactly. **Right.**
- **No public surface changes.** The diff touches four skill rule files and one changeset; no schema, gate, script, ceiling or generated output moves. The four ratchet ceilings in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (2259 / 6232 / 3451 / 5669) are untouched, and the head files read `ceil(bytes/4)` = 2257 / 6231 / 3446 / 5668 (main: 2258 / 6232 / 3451 / 5648) — every file at or under its ceiling, none raised. **Right.**
- **Every wrapper type is the authoring (`z.input`) half of its schema, except one.** `DashboardWidget`, `ListView`, `PageComponent`, `Dashboard` are declared `z.input` of their schemas in `dashboard.zod.ts:1874`, `view.zod.ts:8134`, `page.zod.ts:2287`; `defineAction` / `definePage` take `z.input`. So the dashboards and list-views wrappers (widgets with no `type`, no `layout`) compile because `type` has a default and `layout` is optional on the input half — that matches the rule text ("requires `dataset` + `values`"). `NavigationItem` (app.zod.ts:867) is the OUTPUT union; the input half is `NavigationItemInput` (app.zod.ts:~905, the one `defineApp` consumes). See ④ nit.
- **Fragment notes.** `dashboards.md:241` (the two bare `compareTo:` lines) and `list-views.md:38` (all bare-key blocks) each say once why a block is unmarked, as the card's item 4 asks. **Right.**
- **Gate verdicts on the head.** Every non-skipped check-run that had completed at review time is `success` (Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Type Check · source gates / workspace, Build Core, Test UI, Live E2E UI, …). `check:skill-examples` is NOT in the derived gate list for a `skills/**` diff (the dev ran it by hand); it IS run in CI by `.github/workflows/lint.yml:6322` inside job `typecheck-consumers` = check-run **Type Check · consumer gates**, which concluded **`success`** on `0de24c02` (landed while this record was being written; it is the gate verdict on the ten new marks, not the dev's hand run). 25 of 26 non-skipped check-runs complete, all `success`, 0 failures; Test Core (1/8) was still running and touches no file in this diff.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/31112-ui-skill-examples-checked.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch` (package exists at `packages/skills/package.json`), `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; the PR body carries the same two lines. The diff publishes prose-only changes to four skill rule files — no exported type, schema, enum or runtime path changes — so **patch is the right level**, exactly what card #31112 §Acceptance prescribes per slice and what slices 1 (#31507) and 2 (#31618) used. `Check Changeset` is `success` on the head.

Clause-②: no — confirmed against the tree: no narrowing of any published spec, no capability removed at a consumer.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev flags (report 6727833568 `deviations` + PR body "Acceptance notes"), each answered:

1. *"`check:skill-examples` is not in the derived list; run by hand"* — **answered**: CI runs it in `Type Check · consumer gates` (lint.yml:6322); that check-run's conclusion on `0de24c02` is the gate verdict, not the dev's hand run. Conclusion on the head: **`success`** (see ①), agreeing with the schema reads in ④.
2. *"`SKILL.md` `subforms` block unmarked: fence indented 3 spaces in a list item; `FENCE_OPEN_RE` reads column-0 fences only; headroom 0"* — **verified**: `check-skill-examples.ts:711` `FENCE_OPEN_RE = /^```(ts|tsx|typescript)\s*$/` is anchored at column 0; `SKILL.md:80` opens the fence as `   ```typescript` (three spaces, inside list item 2). Un-indenting would break the list and SKILL.md sits at 3814/3814. Rightly unmarked.
3. *"`list-views.md` `filter`, `sort`, `grouping` unmarked for token headroom (each wrapper ~100 bytes, probed green; 5 tokens left)"* — **verified arithmetically**: head 13783 bytes = 3446 tokens against a 3451 ceiling (5 tokens = 20 bytes); the smallest wrapper (`import type { ListView } …` + `const x: ListView['filter'] = ` + `;`) is well over 20 bytes. Rightly left for a later slice; `data` (`[...]` placeholder), `columns` (two statements) and `userFilters`+`appearance` (two keys) are true fragments.
4. *"no ceiling raised or lowered; the ratchet printed no lowering instruction"* — **verified** (diff touches no script; `Lint · repo & tooling gates` success).
5. *"default tier, no Fable build"* — **answered**: this record is the lane's isolated `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review the claim amendment 6724423900 and claim 6727530009 promised; Tier H approval by a governed approver remains whole-PR and is outside this record.

`open_questions`: none in the report. Serial constraint "PR #31617 (#31487) merged first": verified — `actions.md:25–26` on `main` and on the head carry the helpText locale-map rule unchanged, and `action.zod.ts:194,437` (`actionParamHelpText`, `localeMap: true`) agrees with it. Nothing escalated.

### ④ Design judgment

Method: each new mark's block read against the rule text around it and against the schema in the live tree (`packages/spec/src/ui/*.zod.ts` on `main`); each trim read against the named surviving home on the head; the four `hits` files read against the eval prompts in `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/*.json`.

**`rules/actions.md`** — new mark: `OpenInvoicePdfAction` gains `import { defineAction } from '@objectstack/spec/ui'`. Schema: `opensInNewTab` (action.zod.ts:1906), `newTabUrl` `/^\//` (1931) with the refine "only valid together with `opensInNewTab: true`" (2474) — the block declares both, exactly what the prose above it says; a `type: 'script'` action with `target` and no `body` is legal (`body` optional, 1337). Lesson unchanged. Trims: "the blessed name (same axes and `undefined` cases as hooks…)" → the blessed-name rule lives at `objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md:584` and `:619` (checked); "builds and draws a checkbox in the dialog" → "draws a checkbox" keeps the rule (never express new-tab via `params`). Eval "Convert action … bulk Add to campaign" unaffected. **Holds.**

**`rules/dashboards.md`** — four new marks. (a) dataset-bound widget → `const widget: DashboardWidget` — `id`, `type`, `title`, `dataset`, `dimensions`, `values`, `layout` all declared on `DashboardWidgetSchema` (strict, 1115). (b) `filterBindings` pair → `DashboardWidget[]`: `filterBindings: z.record(string, string | false)` (1406) — `{ region: 'sales_region' }` and `{ task_status: false }` are the two rows of the table above the block; the widgets omit `type`/`layout`, legal on the input half. (c) `compareTo` pair → `DashboardWidget[]` with the comma the fragment lacked; `compareTo: { kind }` is the object form the schema prescribes (370–410). (d) `options` → `DashboardWidget['options']`: `DashboardWidgetOptionsSchema` declares the five keys and is `.passthrough()` (313–368), so this mark checks the five keys' value types and would NOT catch a `sortDirection` typo — consistent with the prose ("a typo parses too, and draws that warning" from `os validate`), so the teaching is not overstated. Trims, each checked on the head: "renderer derives the comparison automatically; no second `filter`" → **Requirements** l.261–262; the KPI comments → **Metric widgets** l.248 and **Cartesian charts** l.252–256 + the §compareTo opening l.229–230; "(binds the crm_task_metrics dataset; filter = runtimeFilter)" → the block's own `dataset:` + l.43–44; "for this widget only" → table row l.347; the pie/donut rationale cut, the rule stays l.257. Eval prompts "date-range filter must re-scope six charts" (`filterBindings`) and "avg days … vs the previous period; slower is worse" (`compareTo` + `polarity`, l.248–251) still answered by the text. **Holds.**

**`rules/list-views.md`** — two new marks. Kanban → `const board: ListView`: `KanbanConfigSchema` (strict, 2359) has `groupByField`, `lanes`, `summarizeField`, `columns` (2364–2438); `type: 'kanban'` is in the view-type enum (3340). A top-level `groupBy` is now a TS2353 against the strict `ListView` shape — the exact rule the heading states ("no top-level `groupBy`"). Gantt → `const timeline: ListView`: `GanttConfigSchema` (strict) requires `startDateField` / `endDateField` / `titleField` and declares `progressField`, `dependenciesField`, `parentField` — matching the prose "required in it". Inside a typed `const`, `data: { provider: 'object', … }` is contextually narrowed, so no `as const` is needed (unlike the `defineView` blocks' hoisted `data`). Trims: "Every view lives under list/form/listViews/formViews" → l.13–14; the `lanes` comment → the note l.276–279; "past the right edge of a narrow screen" → hand-over (a) "scroll right" l.299; "declare `searchableFields` to choose the set" → table row l.182. Eval "add a priority select and a kanban grouped by it … tell them what they will see" asserts `listViews`, `groupByField: 'priority'`, `Uncategorized` — all still taught (l.281–305). **Holds.**

**`rules/pages.md`** — three new marks. `kind: 'html'` page gains `definePage` import; `kind` enum `['full','slotted','html','react']` (page.zod.ts:2133), `source` optional string (2209), `type: 'home'` — the block is the §html tier's one example and now compiles. Pricing card → `const card: PageComponent`: `PageComponentSchema` is strict with `id?`, `type` (vocabulary union), `properties` record, `responsiveStyles: ResponsiveStylesSchema` (strict, keys `large|medium|small|xsmall`, responsive.zod.ts:99) — the block's `large`/`small` maps and `properties.children` are what the Rules list above it prescribes (l.245–258); the cut comment duplicated l.247–252. Doc nav item → `const navigation: NavigationItem[]`: `DocNavItemSchema` (strict, app.zod.ts:793) has `type: 'doc'`, `doc` (regex), `book?`, plus `id`/`label`/`icon` from `BaseNavItemSchema` — compiles and teaches the `doc:` target the prose names; eval "write a user guide … link it from the nav" asserts `type: 'doc'`, still taught. Trims: "use `kind:'react'` for those" → tier table `react` row l.133; "that gives one doc many addresses…" → "so a doc has exactly one URL" l.351–352; "(one source, never a stale copy)" → l.340–342. **Holds**, with one nit:

- **nit** — `pages.md:362–364` types the authoring example with `NavigationItem`, the OUTPUT half of the union (app.zod.ts:867: "what a parse returns"), while the input half `NavigationItemInput` (app.zod.ts:~905) is the type `defineApp(config)` typed as `z.input` of `AppSchema` reads and the one the other three new wrappers in this PR parallel (`DashboardWidget`, `ListView`, `PageComponent` are all `z.input`). For the `doc` arm the two halves are identical (no `.default()` on `DocNavItemSchema` or `BaseNavItemSchema`), so the block compiles and teaches the doc item correctly; a reader who copies `NavigationItem[]` as the type of their own `navigation` array and adds a `url` or `group` item would be asked for `target` / `expanded`, values the schema exists to supply. No effect on this block's correctness or on the contract. Prose-face fix if taken: `NavigationItem` → `NavigationItemInput` (×2, +10 bytes; pages.md has 4 bytes of ceiling left, so it needs a 6-byte trim in the same file) — or leave as an accepted deviation.

Design-break attempts that did not break it: (i) wrappers hiding a wrong lesson — none; every wrapper is one import + a typed `const` on the existing first line (two arrays add `[`/`];`), and each block's keys are the keys the surrounding paragraph names. (ii) a trim removing a rule's only home — each of the 16 cuts was traced to a surviving sentence on the head (named above); the three the dev calls rule-free (": nothing ever drew it", "(the block above)", "(CRUD, live updates, filtering, pagination)") carry no rule. (iii) a mark weaker than the prose implies — only `options` (passthrough bag), and the prose already says the typo "parses too". (iv) the unmarked set — SKILL.md's indented fence and list-views' headroom claim both verified against the gate regex and the byte count. (v) the eval prompts — no `must_contain` string depends on cut text.

No must-fix, no should-fix. One nit; nits alone end the round.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：objectstack-ui 技能里又有 10 段能独立成立的 TypeScript 示例加上 `<!-- os:check -->` 标记，CI 会把它们当真代码编译，覆盖从 15/33 升到 25/33（actions 5/5、dashboards 8/9、list-views 5/11、pages 4/4）。没有发现写错的示例。
- **为什么改**：AI 照抄技能示例写动作、页面、仪表盘和视图，没人编译的示例会在规范改名后悄悄过期。现在键名一错，CI 直接变红（#31112 第 4 项，ui 这一片）。
- **风险与回滚**：只改技能文档，不动运行时，没有抬高任何 token 上限。新增字节靠同文件删掉重复说明支付，每处删掉的规则在同文件另有出处，复审逐条核过。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`（4 段新接入、删减最多），以及 `rules/list-views.md` 把看板和甘特示例改成带 `ListView` 类型的写法。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` 退出 0，统计应为 332 段示例。
- **需要你做的**：批准本 PR（Approve review）。契约复审 PASS 记录是评论 6727980514，Head-sha `0de24c02b390ebefe2fe33fc93cfc97c83f5eec9`；批准后由席位落地。
- **席位意见**：ACCEPT。席位读了 diff：新增的只有标记、类型导入和 `const` 包装，规则教的写法没变；CI 上跑 `check:skill-examples` 的 `Type Check · consumer gates` 在本 head 为 success。

## 席位核对

Head-sha: `0de24c02b390ebefe2fe33fc93cfc97c83f5eec9`

1. **Shape:** draft, base `main`, body `Refs #31112` (slice 3 of a per-skill split; the card stays open), changeset `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. 5 files, +81/−46. Tier H (`skills/**`).
2. **Premise measured:** the slice-2 release note 6727444552 counted ui at 15/33 on `main` 09df5711; its serial PR #31617 (#31487) had merged. The dev's reverse check went red with TS2353 at all 4 planted lines and came back clean, so the marks are live.
3. **Gates:** dev gates 44 derived, 43 exit 0; `dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (needs a full build; no build input touched). `check:skill-examples` 322 → 332 exit 0. Check-runs on this head at ACCEPT: 28 success, 15 skipped, 0 failure, 0 running.
4. **Accepted deviations:** SKILL.md's subforms block stays unmarked, because its fence is indented inside a list item, the gate reads only column-0 fences, and SKILL.md is at 3814/3814 tokens. list-views filter/sort/grouping compile with a wrapper but stay unmarked for want of headroom (3446/3451). Review nit, accepted as is: pages.md:362–364 types the doc-nav example with `NavigationItem` (output half) where `NavigationItemInput` is the authoring half. It is identical on the `doc` arm, so the block compiles and teaches correctly. The rename costs 10 bytes against 4 bytes of headroom, so it rides the next pages.md edit. Model: opus build under the standing no-Fable-build rule, Fable review (claim 6727530009).
5. **Out of scope / Skills-docs:** items 1–3 of #31112, and item 4 for formula and platform, stay on the card; the automation slice stays too. `Metadata-protocol: none`, so no `Skills-docs:` line is owed.
6. **Landing:** Tier H. `pm:awaiting-merge` + reviewers `os-zhuang`, `hotlong`; stays draft until an authorized approval or a maintainer merge. K = 2 first-parent merges since merge-base `9bf32864`. `Refs`, not `Fixes`: the seat releases the card to `pm:queue` with the remaining counts after the merge.
